title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery files for review and approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy a 365-Day Firm Transportation Service Agreement with the Trustees of Hawthorne Place Condominium Trust.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the Company's proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms under the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore, Grants the Company's request for protection form public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul B. Vasington, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC 03-04)
